text: Twenty twenty-eight.
say: [softly] Twenty twenty-eight.

text: Agents draw, listen, speak, and train their own models.
say: Agents draw... listen... speak... and train their own models.

text: Nobody remembers when they couldn't.
say: [pause] Nobody remembers when they couldn't.

text: But in twenty twenty-six, your smartest worker is locked in a room.
say: [sighs] But in twenty twenty-six... your smartest worker is locked in a room.

text: It writes the code for an image model, and never sees the picture.
say: It writes the code for an image model... and never sees the picture.

text: It reads every transcript, and never hears a voice.
say: It reads every transcript... and never hears a voice.

text: And when it needs a GPU, it stops. And waits. For you.
say: [frustrated] And when it needs a GPU... it stops. [pause] And waits. [whispers] For you.

text: Sign up. Pick a GPU. Copy a key. Babysit a server.
say: [quickly] Sign up. Pick a GPU. Copy a key. Babysit a server.

text: Forget it running on Friday, and pay for it on Monday.
say: [whispers] Forget it running on Friday... [pause] and pay for it on Monday.

text: So we opened the door.
say: [determined] So we opened the door.

text: Paste one line, and your agent rents its own GPU, from any provider, in minutes, under your budget.
say: Paste one line... and your agent rents its own GPU. From any provider. In minutes. Under your budget.

text: Any model. Images. Voices. Transcription. Embeddings.
say: [excited] Any model. Images! Voices! Transcription. Embeddings.

text: On an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that every tool you have can call.
say: On an OpenAI-compatible endpoint... that every tool you have can call.

text: Its own code, too: it fine-tunes on your data and hands you a model that is yours.
say: Its own code, too. It fine-tunes on your data... and hands you a model that is yours.

text: Open models, under your rules. The data stays on the machine; the agent sees the results.
say: Open models, under your rules. The data stays on the machine... the agent sees the results.

text: And when the work stops, the GPU stops.
say: [calm] And when the work stops... the GPU stops.

text: A watchdog on the machine shuts it down, even if the chat is closed, even if you're asleep.
say: A watchdog on the machine shuts it down. Even if the chat is closed. [softly] Even if you're asleep.

text: Someday, this will look obvious.
say: [warmly] Someday... this will look obvious.

text: Today, it's one line.
say: Today... it's one line.

text: GPU for Agents. Give your agent a GPU.
say: [excited] GPU for Agents. Give your agent a GPU.
